text:
watcher-bot: PAGER FIRING → High 5xx rate detected on inference-gateway-usw2. 5xx rate jumped from 0.8% to 7.2% in last 2m (threshold 1%). PD: https://pd.example/INC12345 · paging oncall_alex :rotating_light:
Alex: acked. I'm on it, pulling traces and recent deploys. ETA 5m. :point_up:
Maria: seeing a lot of 502/504s from auth-proxy pool-3. Logs show upstream timeouts and 'connection reset by peer' from kvcache-proxy.
Sam: checking rollout — there was a small canary of auth-proxy v2.3.1 deployed 18:12 UTC. Canary traffic 5% to us-west and eu-west. Rolling back canary now.
Alex: running quick check on gateway health:
```
curl -sS "https://gateway-usw2.internal/metrics" | grep http_response_5xx_total
http_response_5xx_total{service="inference-gateway",region="usw2"} 172
http_request_total{service="inference-gateway",region="usw2"} 2389
```
5xx spike concentrated on /v1/generate route.
Maria: kvcache eviction spikes coincident. Sample log: 
```
[2026-03-17T18:14:21Z] kvcache-proxy ERROR evict: shard=4 size=131072 err=timeout
[2026-03-17T18:14:22Z] auth-proxy WARN upstream timeout id=0x7ff4 src=10.2.12.14
```
Sam: rolling rollback completed at 18:16 UTC for canary; promoting old variant back. Decreasing canary weight to 0%. Flushing kvcache pool-3 via maintenance API: `POST /admin/flush?pool=3` (running).
Alex: temporarily bumping circuit-breaker on gateway for /v1/generate to reduce retries and fail fast. Patch applied.
Maria: also increasing kvcache replica count by 1 in us-west and bumping connection pool. K8s rollout starting (rs count +1).
watcher-bot: PD update: Incident acknowledged by oncall_alex at 18:15 UTC. Escalation suppressed.
Sam: early signs of improvement — 5xx rate down to 2.1% in last 30s. Continuing to monitor for error regression and tail latency.
Alex: customer-impact check: large customers on Dedicated may see degraded responses for ~6-8m. Notifying SRE Slack channel and CS/Support. @support please prepare message template.
Jordan: I can take the 30m handoff once things settle, I'm on next rotation.
Maria: cache flush finished, kvcache evictions normalized. No OOMs observed.
Alex: lowering alert amplification and adding a temporary filter to avoid noisy PD pages for 5xx bursts while we stabilize.
Sam: plan: (1) verify rollback fully across regions, (2) keep circuit-breaker temporary settings 15m, (3) run greedy tracer aggregation to check for residual slow upstreams.
Alex: Metrics dashboard snapshot: https://grafana.example/d/abcd/inference-gateway?from=now-15m&to=now — please review.
Jordan: ack taking handoff once Alex posts an all-clear. I'll maintain watch and have escalation steps ready.
Alex: All-clear for handoff now? 5xx steady ~0.6% last 5m. I'll hand off to Jordan in 3m. Leaving this thread for the handoff note.
watcher-bot: Incident resolved: auto-alert suppressed after 15m stabilization. Summary: Canary auth-proxy v2.3.1 rollback + kvcache replica bump + temporary circuit-breaker adjustments mitigated spike. PD INC12345 closed by alex at 18:34 UTC. :white_check_mark:
Jordan: taking over monitoring. If anything flares up, ping me and I'll page. :thumbsup:
